instruction: Attach a layer mask to this layer, and start it fully transparent rather than opaque.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc', format: 'sexpr', key: 'layer-add-mask-type', default: 'white' } ] }); return data[0]; }
async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc', format: 'sexpr', key: 'layer-add-mask-invert', default: 'no' } ] }); return data[0]; }
